name: Ishaan Gupta
headline: Graduate Machine Learning Engineer
summary: Computer science graduate (2026) with two internships in applied machine learning, looking for a first full-time role building models that reach real users.

experience.title: Machine Learning Intern
bullets: Trained a PyTorch computer vision model that grades produce quality from photos, reaching 88% accuracy.
Wrote Python data-augmentation scripts that grew the training set from 3,000 to 18,000 images.
Presented the results to the founders; the model is now in a pilot with two wholesalers.

experience.title: Data Science Intern
bullets: Pulled six months of order data with SQL and cleaned it with pandas for a churn analysis.
Built a scikit-learn churn model that the retention team used to target 2,000 at-risk customers.
Automated a weekly Python report that replaced three hours of manual spreadsheet work.

projects.name: Leaf-disease classifier
projects.description: Final-year project: a PyTorch computer vision model that identifies 12 tomato leaf diseases from phone photos.

projects.name: Elective recommender
projects.description: A Python and scikit-learn recommender for university electives, used by 300 students in its first term.
